records.failure: Configured DeepSeek provider does not use the requested canonical DEEPSEEK_API_KEY alias.
records.hypothesis: A legacy configuration uses the noncanonical DEEPSEEK-api-key environment variable.
records.minimal_change: None in P1; preserve configuration and record the mismatch.
records.evidence: Canonical alias absent; configured alias present and accepted one redacted official balance request.
records.result: Qualified account availability only; P3 completion/tool surface remains blocked.
records.limitation: A balance response does not validate the configured gateway, tool loop, or cost envelope.
records.rollback_boundary: No configuration modification without explicit user direction; no second balance probe.
